content.text: Genetic disorder due to 3 copies of chromosome 21 (
) or 3 copies of a region of the long arm of chromosome 21
MC chromosomal disorder & cause of mental developmental disability
•low-set small ears, flat facial profile, flat nasal bridges
– white, grey, or brown spots on the iris
•hyperflexibility of the joints, short broad hands
increased space between first & second toes
: duodenal or esophageal atresia, Hirschsprung disease
•placental tissue sample retrieved via vagina & cervix
Postnatal dx → FISH, karyotyping; clinical based on dysmorphic features
chorionic villous sampling or amniocentesis is offered
: prenatal genetic counseling; supportive for affected body systems
